INPUT_SOURCES.quote: The input token count itself must be less than the model context window size. K3 context is 1048576; the inclusive integer input ceiling is therefore 1048575. The API reduces generation to remaining context.
The input token count itself must be less than the model context window size. K2 context is 262144; the inclusive integer input ceiling is therefore 262143.

EFFORT_SOURCES.quote: Reasoning.effort supports: none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh, and max.
Reasoning.effort supports: none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh, and max.
Reasoning.effort supports: none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh, and max.
OpenAI reasoning_effort minimal / low / medium / high maps to Argon thinking_level low / low / medium / high, and to the identically named Gemini 3 Flash / 3.1 Flash-Lite levels.
The Chat Completions example explicitly sends model="gemini-3.8-flash", reasoning_effort="low". Other wire values are not asserted from native thinking levels.
The Gemini 2.5 compatibility column maps minimal / low / medium / high to budgets 1024 / 1024 / 8192 / 24576; thinking cannot be disabled for 2.5 Pro.
For 2.5 models reasoning_effort="none" disables thinking, except for 2.5 Pro. The remaining wire levels use the documented 2.5 budget mapping.
grok-4.5 supports low / medium / high. xhigh is treated as high rather than a distinct supported level.
grok-4.6 and grok-4.7 support low / medium / high / xhigh. Reasoning cannot be disabled.
K3 series supports top-level reasoning_effort low / high / max. K3.1 Pro and its highspeed variant explicitly have the same parameter constraints as K3. K2.x does not support reasoning_effort.
The glm-5.3 API supports reasoning_effort low / high / max; thinking.type must be enabled.
The listed lowercase Flash/FlashX Model Codes use the same text parameters as GLM-5.3, whose documented reasoning_effort values are low / high / max.
The enumerated models accept all seven Chat API reasoning_effort values; none maps to minimal (thinking off), and xhigh / max map to high.
